title: A Goose Flew Over the Himalayas at 23,000 Feet

scenes.text: A goose flew over the Himalayas at 23,000 feet.
Bar-headed geese cross the tallest mountains on Earth.
One tracked bird reached 7,290 metres, almost 24,000 feet.
Some cross non-stop in as little as seven hours.
They fly at night, when cold, dense air gives them more lift.
Humans struggle to breathe up there. These geese just keep flapping.

description:
Bar-headed geese cross the Himalayas, and one tracked bird reached 7,290 metres.
Some make the crossing non-stop in as little as seven hours, flying mostly at night.
Would you have guessed a goose could do it?
first_comment: Which would you rather cross, the Himalayas on foot or in a goose's wings?
